articles.title: CISA Offers Free Security Tools to Protect Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace From Cyber Threats
articles.summary:
The Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) offers two free assessment tools, ScubaGear and ScubaGoggles, to help organizations identify insecure configurations in Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace.
